turns.speaker: Alice
turns.text: I'm flying to Tokyo on May 3rd for a conference.

turns.speaker: Bob
turns.text: Nice — which conference?

turns.speaker: Alice
turns.text: NeurIPS regional. I'll be there three days.

turns.speaker: Bob
turns.text: Are you presenting?

turns.speaker: Alice
turns.text: Yes, a talk on Wednesday morning.

turns.speaker: Alice
turns.text: Finished my talk prep last night.

turns.speaker: Bob
turns.text: What's the talk about?

turns.speaker: Alice
turns.text: Local memory systems for consumer apps.

turns.speaker: Bob
turns.text: Cool — staying in Shibuya again?

turns.speaker: Alice
turns.text: No, this time I booked a hotel in Shinjuku near the venue.

turns.speaker: Alice
turns.text: Just landed at Haneda, exhausted.

turns.speaker: Bob
turns.text: How was the flight?

turns.speaker: Alice
turns.text: Eleven hours from JFK. I watched two movies and slept four hours.

turns.speaker: Carol
turns.text: I'm leaving Stripe to start a company.

turns.speaker: Dan
turns.text: Whoa, what are you building?

turns.speaker: Carol
turns.text: A privacy-first memory system for Mac users. Working title: Loom.

turns.speaker: Dan
turns.text: Are you raising?

turns.speaker: Carol
turns.text: Pre-seed, $1.5M target.

turns.speaker: Carol
turns.text: Got the term sheet from Sequoia today.

turns.speaker: Dan
turns.text: On the original $1.5M?

turns.speaker: Carol
turns.text: They wanted to lead at $2.5M instead, so we upsized.

turns.speaker: Dan
turns.text: Valuation?

turns.speaker: Carol
turns.text: $15M post.

turns.speaker: Carol
turns.text: Renamed Loom to Memex — the original name was trademarked.

turns.speaker: Dan
turns.text: First hire?

turns.speaker: Carol
turns.text: An ML engineer named Priya, joining May 1.

turns.speaker: Ethan
turns.text: Signed up for the Boston Marathon. Race day is April 20.

turns.speaker: Fiona
turns.text: Nice! Goal time?

turns.speaker: Ethan
turns.text: Sub-3:00 is the dream, but realistically 3:10.

turns.speaker: Fiona
turns.text: How are you training?

turns.speaker: Ethan
turns.text: Hanson method, 6 days a week, peaking at 60 miles.

turns.speaker: Ethan
turns.text: Did a 22-mile long run today at marathon pace.

turns.speaker: Fiona
turns.text: How'd it feel?

turns.speaker: Ethan
turns.text: Tough at mile 18 but I held 7:00/mile.

turns.speaker: Fiona
turns.text: That puts you on track for sub-3:00.

turns.speaker: Ethan
turns.text: Yeah, I'm cautiously optimistic.

turns.speaker: Ethan
turns.text: Finished Boston in 2:58:42!

turns.speaker: Fiona
turns.text: You crushed your goal!

turns.speaker: Ethan
turns.text: It rained the last 10K but I held pace.
